findings.claim: A3.2 says it covers all remaining PEND classes from the A3 map (line 3). Its §3 EX/PC only handles eleven R-0007 TASKs. The map also marks four R-0014 files as PEND: EX: TASK-0010, TASK-0011, TASK-0012 (which is also TITLE) and TASK-0022 (A3-source-map.md:141-143,151). All four carry `executor.note`, which `agentExecutor` rejects because it sets `additionalProperties: false`. Their `selection` and `PC-[a-f0-9]{16}` values are valid. Neither A3.2 nor the reconstruction addendum gives these files a projection, a source or an Owner decision, so they stay source_pending and are missing from the decision table.
findings.fix: Add a section for these four files. One option is to preserve `executor.note` only in the A3 sidecar and drop it from the canonical projection under A3 §5, with the before/after report recording it. That needs an explicit S or Owner decision. Otherwise declare them source_pending and add a row to the decision table.

findings.claim: STATUS=A projects S2 and S3 to `checkpoint` but does not tell the Owner what that status does at runtime. In the pinned runtime (@aarusso-nyx/devai 1.5.6, dist/runtime/index/release-host.js), `TERMINAL = {completed, escalated, cancelled}`. `escalateRoundTask` and `pauseRoundTask` both accept `checkpoint` (lines ~188411-188435). A historical TASK would become a live, non-terminal node that accepts lifecycle transitions. Completed TASK-0004-S2-R1 would then sit downstream of non-terminal S2. The addendum itself admits that no guard currently blocks dispatch or transition of an archival PC (expc-reconstruction.md:58). The proposal also presents this as a 'new convention' without mentioning that R-0007 TASK-0038 already has `status: checkpoint`.
findings.fix: Document these runtime semantics and the TASK-0038 precedent in STATUS. Compare them with the alternatives in the enum and their effects on seal and scheduler. Make STATUS=A conditional on a verifiable guard against transition or dispatch, or recommend STATUS=B until that guard exists.

findings.claim: ROLE=A would set `discipline: owner`, the governance authority source in the schema, on files whose authority by path is not Owner. Constitution Art. 6 gives `product/` to Owner and `docs/` plus root prose to Architect. R-0003 `prompts/TASK-0004.md` §Pode tocar lists `docs/framework/arch/dashboard-build-pack.md`, `docs/meta/knowledge-base/*` and `apps/dashboard/web/README.md`, and the JSON declares `target_substrates: [F2]`. R-0005 TASK-0009 has `MOD-docs`/F2. The conflict is already provable from the sources, but the proposal hands it to a later Inspector check. It also rules out Architect without showing the Owner that neither option is free of conflict.
findings.fix: State the Art. 6/7 conflict explicitly for both options, owner and architect (the later convention 'Architect (transcr.)' in R-0012/R-0016 plan.md). Ask the Owner for a specific decision, for example an archival tag with `legacy-discipline` and an explicit exception or an alternative. Do not recommend A as if it were supported by a source.

findings.claim: The package recipe is ambiguous at the bytes that get hashed. Step 3 writes `review_bridge_path` as `reviews/attempt-2/ctg-0002-final{,-2,-3}.bridge.json`, relative to the round, but `source_path` is relative to the repo. The table candidates for 0078, 0080 and 0082 (PC-22b18cc1bd9af201, PC-1766eb9f01d0bafa, PC-10b9b527af7d35af) only reproduce with `work/rounds/R-0007/reviews/attempt-2/…`. Using the literal text of step 3 gives PC-4c3232c4b986f879, PC-3c4dd3f6180955cb and PC-250324630f552b39. Step 3 also requires the bridge hash to be the 'hash exato de reports/A3.2-expc-receipts.md', but that report lists no bridge SHA-256. The actual values are dc07c754…4583, c6e3fd82…c90d and bff8f502…4980.
findings.fix: State that every path in the package is relative to the repo root and correct the text of step 3. Add the full SHA-256 of the three `.bridge.json` files to the receipts report, or name the correct source. Recompute the candidates and have Inspector confirm them before they go to the Owner.

findings.claim: The proposal calls the positions an 'Architect→Inspector→Engineer triad'. In the runtime, `COUPLED_POSITION` is inspector 0 < architect 1 < engineer 2, and `taskDependencies` adds an edge from every lower position in the same CTG. Under POS=A, TASK-0004 (architect) would depend on S1 (inspector) even though S1.upstream is TASK-0004. S4 (engineer) would depend on S5 (architect) even though S5.upstream is S4. The edges are ignored only while the TASKs are terminal, and STATUS=A would break that. The open question about how `null` is read already has an answer in the code: a null position creates no position edge, and group membership stays.
findings.fix: Record the real order and the edges POS=A induces. Tie POS approval to the TASKs staying terminal. Close the question about `null` by citing the runtime instead of leaving it as an open Owner decision.

findings.claim: UP=A creates a 'verifiable archival index of non-TASK preconditions' but gives no path, format or verifier. The temporal proof also has to deal with retries. R-0007/plan.md:1311 and 1361-1364 show PREP-CTG1-MODEL conditioned on a gate, plus a sensor-error and a reference-gap before completion.
findings.fix: Fix the path and fields of the PREP index: round, literal, plan/prompt reference, completion evidence and a timestamp before TASK-0002 dispatch. Require proof of the final successful occurrence, not just any mention.

findings.claim: The decision table leaves out decisions that the addendum and the map still depend on. From the addendum: authorizing B, meaning a new archival PC (per file); prospective `selection` for the six S* TASKs; a runtime dispatch guard for `archival-pc-provenance:reconstructed-v1`; and approval of the eleven candidates. From the map: a destination for EV/REC/TRAIL when the semantics must stay active (A3-source-map.md:13). The plan.md entries (lines 308 and 487) still say EX/PC is 'under receipt search' and do not index `reports/A3.2-expc-receipts.md` or the reconstruction addendum.
findings.fix: Consolidate one table of Owner decisions covering A3.2 and the addendum, including the four R-0014 EX files. Update R-0020/plan.md with the paths and state of the receipts and the addendum.
